cards.name: The Keeper of the Yellow Hat

faces.name: The Keeper of the Yellow Hat
faces.oracleText:
You can't cast Keeper of the Yellow Hat during your first seven turns of the game. (Keep track if you're playing with this!)
When The Keeper of the Yellow Hat enters the battlefield, create a legendary artifact equipment token named Yellow Hat with equip {2} and "Equipped creature gets +4/+4 and gains lifelink."

faces.name: The Kenriths' Royal Funeral
faces.oracleText:
When The Kenriths' Royal Funeral enters, exile up to two target legendary creature cards from your graveyard. You draw X cards and you lose X life, where X is the greatest mana value among cards exiled this way.
Legendary spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each card exiled with The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.

faces.name: The Key to the Vault
faces.oracleText:
Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may exile a nonland card from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
Equip {2}{U}

faces.name: The King of Grixis
faces.oracleText:
Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch.
Whenever one or more other creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, sacrifice one of them. You may cast a Grixis spell from your hand without paying its mana cost. If you don't, choose a random Grixis card and create a copy of it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. (A Grixis spell is exactly blue, black, and red.)
Partner—King and Queen (You can have two commanders if they both have this ability)

faces.name: The Kingpin of Crime
faces.oracleText:
Extort (Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B}. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much life.)
Whenever you attack, you may pay 2 life. If you do, until end of turn, creatures you control with toughness greater than their power assign combat damage equal to their toughness rather than their power.

faces.name: The Kinnan Hirer
faces.oracleText:
Flying, vigilance
Whenever The Kinnan Hirer enters or deals combat damage to a player, create a Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy token, except it's not legendary.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{5}{G}{U}: Activate the 5GU ability of each creature named Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy you control.

faces.name: The Knight of Commentary
faces.oracleText: Eminence — While The Knight of Commentary is in the command zone or on the battlefield, you are freely allowed to ask people for advice on your game while playing. (This includes nearby players, friends around you, and even people you message on your phone, but it all must be done in a timely fashion, courteously, and without causing large interruptions in other games.)

faces.name: The Knight of Land Drops
faces.oracleText:
Partner with Knight (You may select any legendary Knight to be this creature's partner. It doesn't have to have Partner. You don't search for a Knight when this enters the battlefield.)
Knights you control have haste and "At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't play a land this turn, you may discard a card, then draw a card."
